objective: Pick up Shay's Bell from the chest.
Escort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.

description: Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.
There is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.
Inside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.
progress: I was gettin' worried 'bout ya! Thank you so much for bringin' Shay home, <name>.
completion: What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!
Since you did so much fer me, here ya go, <name>.
